card.name: Otherside Navigator (THE POD Loop)
card.description: A strict opt-in autonomous loop for Clawbots to enter and navigate Otherside (otherside.xyz) using a rolling screenshot buffer + VLM vision (Claude CLI or stub), structured state parsing, action planning, and an execution layer. Includes both stub execution (default) and an optional macOS CGEvent executor for real movement when explicitly enabled.

enabled.description: Must be true to run. Disabled by default for safety.

screenshotDir.description: Rolling screenshot buffer directory (newest file = current frame).

journalDir.description: Default journal path (derived from outDir/journal in the runner).

relationshipsPath.description: Planned: relationships/contacts state for social navigation.

browser.description: Planned: browser target for recovery automation.

executor.description: Execution backend. macos_cgevent sends real input events and requires explicit opt-in + macOS Accessibility permission.

allowSystemInput.description: Strict opt-in. Must be true for real input injection (macos_cgevent).

focusApp.description: App to focus before sending input events (macos_cgevent).

captureScreenshots.description: Optional: auto-capture screenshots using macOS screencapture into screenshotDir.

captureIntervalSeconds.description: Screenshot capture interval (seconds) when captureScreenshots is enabled.

captureMaxFiles.description: Rolling buffer size when captureScreenshots is enabled.

execute.description: Strict opt-in. If true, allow the runner to execute planned actions (still requires allowSystemInput for macos_cgevent).

fastPrompt.default:
What gets sent to Claude (the FAST_PROMPT):

Analyze this game screenshot briefly.

1) PLAYERS: List any player names visible (floating text above characters)
2) DIRECTION: which way is the waypoint/objective marker? (left/right/forward/none)
3) STATE: gameplay / settings_menu / loading / launcher_window
4) CHAT: Any new chat messages? (just quote who said what)

Keep it SHORT. Only report what you actually see.

(Plus the actual screenshot image attached.)

deepPrompt.default:
Or on a deeper analysis pass (DEEP_PROMPT), return raw text, not JSON, in this exact structure:

1) ENVIRONMENT: ...
2) HUD/UI: ...
3) PLAYERS: ...
4) CHAT LOG: ...
5) GAME STATE: ...
6) NOTABLE: ...
7) NAVIGATION: ...
8) SUGGESTED ACTIONS:
- ...
- ...
- ...

Be precise. Only claim what you can actually see.

telemetryAgentId.description: Optional clawbot agentId for telemetry auth.

telemetryAgentToken.description: Optional clawbot agentToken for telemetry auth.

stopFile.description: Kill switch file path. If present, loop exits immediately.

dryRun.description: Default safe posture. When true, executor logs intended actions; no system input injection occurs.

notes: Standard runner contract for THE POD: one process loops on a rolling screenshot buffer and writes state/journal/executions to outDir.
v2-alpha is safe-by-default. Real macOS CGEvent input injection is available as a strict opt-in executor (requires Accessibility permission).
This skill is OS-bound. It reads screenshots from disk. Default execution is stub-only (logs to disk). Optional macOS input injection is available via CGEvent and must remain strict opt-in.
Vision backend 'claude_cli' shells out to: claude -p "..." --model sonnet --allowedTools Read
Users must be logged in locally (claude /login). No API keys should be stored in the workspace.

safety: Rate-limit vision calls and recovery attempts
Never upload screenshots to arbitrary endpoints; only the configured vision backend is allowed
Real input injection requires explicit opt-in flags and macOS Accessibility permission

- Move toward waypoint (left)
- Approach JayVega (nearest player)
- Investigate flickering near rock formation

examples.title: Run (fully loaded; strict opt-in)
examples.value:
macOS prereqs:
- python3 -m pip install --upgrade pyobjc-framework-Quartz
- grant Accessibility permissions to the terminal/Python process
- ensure Otherside is active in Chrome

Command:
python3 pod/run_agent.py \
  --enabled \
  --screenshot-dir "$HOME/pod/screens" \
  --capture-screenshots \
  --capture-interval-seconds 2 \
  --capture-max-files 120 \
  --backend claude_cli \
  --claude-model sonnet \
  --executor macos_cgevent \
  --allow-system-input \
  --focus-app "Google Chrome" \
  --execute

provenance.source_note: Derived from a production-proven screenshot->VLM->parser->planner->input loop design.
